# Droparabia

> Droparabia is the first dropshipping platform built for Lebanon, and soon the wider MENA
> region. Sellers pick products from a vetted catalog, sell them on their own Shopify store,
> and Droparabia handles sourcing, stock, packaging and delivery. Sellers are charged per
> item sold, so there is no inventory to buy upfront.

Droparabia was created to remove the obstacles that cause most e-commerce and dropshipping
businesses to fail before they start: large upfront investments, renting warehouses, buying
stock in bulk that may not sell, sourcing from unreliable suppliers, and finding a delivery
partner. It is aimed at anyone starting an online business, regardless of prior experience,
technical skill or education.

How it works: you integrate your Shopify store with Droparabia, which lets you add and sell
any catalog product directly on your own website. Droparabia tracks stock and inventory for
every product, so you manage no inventory, and handles packaging and delivery each time a
customer orders from your store. You are charged per item sold, so you only pay for what you
sold rather than purchasing stock.

Droparabia runs its own logistics network in Deir Qoubel, Mount Lebanon Governorate, with its
own delivery infrastructure covering Lebanon, plus supplier partners locally and in China.
Founded by Majd Abdulsalam, a digital marketing specialist and e-commerce brand builder.

## Tools

- [Find Products](https://droparabia.com/tools/find-products): A catalog of in-demand, proven products. Filter by niche, order a physical sample before committing, and one-click import to Shopify.
- [AI Winning Products](https://droparabia.com/tools/ai-winning-products): Each product gets an AI score out of 100 across trend, competition, margin, saturation, impulse buy and repeat-purchase potential, plus a target-audience analysis and a sell recommendation.
- [AI Studio](https://droparabia.com/tools/ai-studio): Generate your own product ad images and videos from your own prompts, instead of reusing other creators' content.
- [Branding](https://droparabia.com/tools/branding): Print on demand per sold item, so you build a branded store without paying upfront to private-label a bulk order.
- [Product Request](https://droparabia.com/tools/product-request): Send an image of a product you want and Droparabia sources it for you, with no extra sourcing fee.
- [Leader Board](https://droparabia.com/tools/leader-board): See how your store ranks against other sellers, with events, giveaways and an affiliate program for top performers.

## Main pages

- [Droparabia](https://droparabia.com): Homepage — what the platform is, how it works, and the full tool set.
- [Dropvault community](https://droparabia.com/dropvault): Every Droparabia user is a member of Dropvault: 20+ hours of free courses and recorded tutorials, weekly coaching calls with advisors, occasional giveaways, and a dedicated WhatsApp support group.
- [FAQ](https://droparabia.com/faq): Answers to the most common questions, including the refund policy — a full refund plus compensation for time and money lost if a user followed all instructions and made full use of the platform (with proof provided) but made no sales within 90 days.
- [Reviews](https://droparabia.com/reviews): Reviews written by Droparabia sellers.
- [About](https://droparabia.com/about): The company, its founder, and the logistics operation behind it.
- [Leave a review](https://droparabia.com/leave-review): Form for sellers to submit their own review.

## Notes

- Droparabia is not a get-rich-quick scheme. It is for people serious about building a business and ready to put in the effort; the platform makes starting easier, but success depends on the seller's own work.
- Unlike traditional e-commerce, there is no need to buy hundreds of products upfront and store them — products can be tested with zero inventory risk.
- The site is available in English, Arabic and French.
- Droparabia currently ships within Lebanon, with MENA expansion planned.
